the nocturnal exchange between the Amazon forest canopies and the atmosphere is dominated by low-frequency, non-local processes, with a significant impact on the exchange of CO2 and O3.

the exchange between the forest and its atmosphere cannot be understood without considering the temporal scales of the exchange processes, especially in the very stable conditions typical of the Amazonian forest.
